title: Prove the sync cabinet's SQL Server answers: TCP, a login-free pre-login and the certificate it presents

hypotheses.statement: The SQL Server port answers, but not as SQL Server
SQL Server requires encryption with a certificate a checking client would not trust
Could not check SQL Server on the sync cabinet

limits: Runs only when the site's sync ports include 1433, SQL Server's default port
Stops before any login: it proves SQL Server answers, not that the sync software can sign in
A port that is closed or silent is reported by the network diagnosis's own port tests, not here

escalation.when: SQL Server answers here but the sync still fails: the cause is past the connection (sign-in, the database, the sync software)
